top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single part for the physiology of GLP-1 and its active forms to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The discovery is a mature, complete chain from proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide through glucose-dependent insulin secretion and appetite effects to therapies with benefit confirmed in large independent trials. The three-name allocation and the citation scope are defensible. Mojsov's priority relative to Habener's group and the exclusion of Knudsen are real limits, but a contested priority is not a refuted one and they do not justify withholding the award.
recusal_note: Profile records about twenty co-authored works with chair Per Svenningsson and one with Abdel El Manira (2009), plus earlier Salk co-authorship with Ronald Evans; none relates to the credited laureates, so no recusal appears required.
